name: Matsuri
source:
While she is [url=/c145784]Tsumi[/url]'s classmate, Matsuri's mannerisms and demeanor often give off the image of her being older and more mature than she actually is. She often acts flirty and suggestive towards Tsumi, and she particularly enjoys the way he reacts when she gets all close to him. She frequently wears revealing clothes and sometimes even goes around not wearing a bra.

[From [url=https://www.purplesoftware.jp/products/lipm/character.html]official website[/url]]
